notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Hello Players,[/b]

I’d like to update you on an issue that some players encountered when joining the lobby. As you know, each player is assigned a random character at the start of the game. Due to a technical issue with one of these characters, players who received it were experiencing problems when entering the lobby.

I’ve identified the source of the issue and applied the necessary fix. You should now be able to enter the lobby without any problems.

Thank you for your patience and understanding during this process. Enjoy the game!

Best regards,
[b]The Soul[/b]
